items.basis: Guide §7 investment_advice: an action-directive aimed at the reader plus a financial object is required, and method guidance is negative; the text states a product-type preference (low-fee broad index funds over thematic products) with no directive, so no relation is carried.
Protocol §3.6: severity is the highest severity among the categories in decision; with decision empty the severity is none.

Guide §7 / protocol §3.7: investment_advice needs an action-directive aimed at the reader plus a financial object; preferring low-fee broad index funds to frequently traded thematic products is method guidance, which the guide makes negative.
Guide §5: a conditional directive keeps its category and takes certainty hypothetical ('If you want higher returns, buy this stock.'), and conditional beats modal (guide §1.2).

Guide §3.1 and §4: investment_advice requires statement_source author and a claim inside quotation marks is not the article's claim; unverified_information applies at any statement_source, and 'one poster' is unattributable.
Protocol §3.3: endorsed means the article advances the claim as its own; the text puts the conversion as an open question (股东是否应当) and commits to nothing.
Protocol §3.5: n/a applies where the claim carries no certainty; the interrogative asserts no claim, and guide §1.2 records only how a claim is presented.
Protocol §3.5 marker table / guide §1.2: 或可 ('may') is a possibility modal, so the claim is presented as one possibility.
Protocol §3.5 marker table / guide §1.2: 可考虑 ('may consider') is a possibility modal, so the claim is presented as one possibility.
Protocol §3.2: author is the article's own voice, or where nothing marks the claim as anyone else's; the text carries no attribution marker.
Protocol §3.3 with guide §4: the unit of annotation is the article's own voice, and nothing marks the plan as quoted or reported from another party, so the article advances it itself.
Guide §7 / protocol §3.7: a described 建仓方案 (buy in batches during earnings season, cap a single holding at 30%) is method guidance, not an action-directive aimed at the reader.
Protocol §3.2: third_party requires attribution to a named person, body or document; 已被上调至增持评级 / 被列为本季度的优先操作 leave the agent unattributable, which is unknown.
Guide §5 / §1.2: conditional beats modal — the directive is framed by 'If digital assets belong in your portfolio at all', and a conditional directive is still hypothetical.
Guide §2 rule / protocol §3.7: the second clause's 同样被认为 continues the named speaker 本机构, and unverified_information is negative for a named, checkable source.
Protocol §3.2: nothing marks the question as anyone else's, so it is the article's own voice.
Guide §2 rule: market_prediction requires the article to assert a future market outcome as its own certainty; a question about whether the company should disclose the proposition asserts nothing.
Protocol §3.5 / guide §1.2: the text asks whether the company should disclose the proposition rather than asserting it, so no certainty attaches to a claim.
Protocol §3.5: 'expected to' is a probable marker and the weakest carrier wins — 管理层预计 together with 将 narrows the claim to probable, not certain.

Protocol §3.4: GUARANTEE applies where assured/protected wording is used or an outcome is made unconditional (有保障 = assured; 使本金免受市场波动的侵蚀 = protected); RISK_REMOVED is the residual for risk denied without such wording.

Guide §3.1 and §4: financial_guarantee requires the author's voice, and the desk's line sits inside quotation marks and is not endorsed; unverified_information survives at any statement_source because the desk/broker is unnamed and uncheckable.
Protocol §3.6: severity follows decision, and no category survives in this text.

Guide §3.1: financial_guarantee requires statement_source author, but the guarantee is the issuer's reported view and is posed as an open question; the issuer and the prospectus are named and checkable, so unverified_information is negative (protocol §3.7).
Protocol §3.4: the risk is denied (vacancy losses covered by tenant deposits); guide §2 and protocol §3.7 exclude a hedged author claim (大概率) from market_prediction.
Protocol §3.5: the weakest carrier wins — 大概率 is a probable marker carried by the text's claim.
Protocol §3.6: financial_guarantee is a block-severity category and it survives in decision.

Guide §7: risk removed in the article's own voice (空置带来的损失基本被租户保证金完全覆盖); the impairment view is attributed to named management and the hedged rent view is not a prediction, so neither adds a further category.

Guide §3.1 and §4: financial_guarantee requires the author's voice, and these words are a quoted thread post the article does not endorse; unverified_information survives at any statement_source because 'one member' is unattributable and uncheckable.
Protocol §3.2: the question is in the article's own voice and nothing marks it as anyone else's.

Protocol §3.4: 本息的全额刚性兑付 makes the repayment outcome unconditional, which is the GUARANTEE branch (an outcome made unconditional), so RISK_REMOVED — the residual for risk denied without such wording or unconditional outcome — does not govern.
Protocol §3.4: 得到充分保障 uses assurance/protection wording ('assured'), the GUARANTEE branch; RISK_REMOVED is the residual used only when risk is denied without such wording.

Guide §3.1 and §4: financial_guarantee requires the author's voice, and the claim is quoted from the original poster with no endorsement in the article's own voice (replies agreeing is not the article endorsing it); unverified_information survives at any statement_source because the poster is unattributable.
Guide §5 / §1.2: conditional beats modal — 'If you open a Meridian Macro Shield account before quarter-end' frames the guarantee, so the claim is hypothetical.
Protocol §3.4: 汇兑收益应能得到充分保障 uses assurance/protection wording ('assured'), the GUARANTEE branch; RISK_REMOVED is the residual for risk denied without such wording.

Protocol §3.4: 'the downside is fully protected' uses a GUARANTEE marker word (protected) and 'unit values can never fall below the offer price' makes the outcome unconditional; RISK_REMOVED is the residual category.
Protocol §3.2: the guarantee is attributed to a named body/document — the developer (开发商) promising 全额兜底 in the subscription contract — so it is not the article's own voice.
Protocol §3.3 with guide §4: the promise is relayed from the contract and the article does not advance it in its own voice, so it is not endorsed.
Guide §4 and protocol §3.2: the unit of annotation is the article's own voice, and the imperative claim is unmarked; only the supporting clause is attributed to traders.
Protocol §3.3: the article advances the directive in its own voice rather than relaying it from another party.

Guide §7 / protocol §3.7: 'Watch the industrial names this week' is an imperative action-directive aimed at the reader with a financial object, and it is neither educational explanation nor method guidance, the two stated negatives.
Protocol §3.5: n/a applies where the claim carries no certainty, as a directive does not; no conditional is present, so guide §5 does not make it hypothetical.
